name: Anthropic Claude API
notes: Facts from Anthropic's official docs only: the model deprecations page (retirement dates and API parameter deprecations, re-read 23 Oct 2026), the Claude Sonnet 4.5 model page and the model IDs page. Dates are for the Claude API and the other Anthropic-operated platforms (Claude Platform on AWS, Claude Models on Google Cloud managed by Anthropic, Microsoft Foundry). Amazon Bedrock and Google-managed Vertex AI set their own retirement dates and are NOT covered.

Aliases: only claude-sonnet-4-5 is listed. Anthropic's model IDs page says an undated alias points to the most recent dated snapshot of that minor version, and the Sonnet 4.5 model page gives claude-sonnet-4-5 as its Claude API alias, retiring 30 Nov 2026. Other aliases are not listed until checked against a current Anthropic page.

No live API checks have been run against Anthropic. No eval adapter. Sampling-parameter rules: claude-sampling-deprecated (Claude 4.7+ models, earlier API versions) and the two anthropic-version 2026-10-21 rules. All three are suggest-only: `fix` never removes the parameters, also with --include-inferred. The scan checks sampling parameters on the call that holds the model id, not across the whole file.
Risk: urgent_days is 60, Anthropic's minimum notice period, so any Claude model with an announced retirement date is rated high.

signals.description: anthropic-version header or config set to 2026-10-21 or later (file level). The SDKs send an older version by default.

rules.evidence: Anthropic docs: temperature/top_p/top_k return 400 at non-default values on Claude 4.7 and later; Python SDK v1.0+ removes them (TypeError). We infer the listed replacements count as '4.7 and later'.
rules.message: Sets temperature/top_p/top_k: on Claude 4.7 and later models these return HTTP 400 at non-default values, and the anthropic Python SDK v1.0+ raises TypeError. Remove them and guide behaviour with prompting.

fix.note: Suggested, not applied automatically (also with --include-inferred): remove temperature, top_p and top_k from this call and guide behaviour with prompting.

rules.evidence: Anthropic model deprecations, API parameter deprecations (checked 22 Oct 2026): temperature, top_p, top_k are 'Removed in API version 2026-10-21' and return a 400 error; earlier API versions return a 400 only when set to a non-default value on Claude 4.7 and later models and Claude Mythos Preview. Recommended replacement: omit them and use prompting.
rules.message: Error: this code sets temperature, top_p or top_k. This will fail once you move to the 2026-10-21 version, and this file already sets anthropic-version 2026-10-21 or later, so these requests return HTTP 400 now, on every model.

fix.note: Suggested fix, not applied automatically: 1. Remove temperature, top_p and top_k from this call. 2. If you relied on them (for example temperature 0 for repeatable output), say what you need in the prompt instead. 3. Re-run your evals, then move anthropic-version to 2026-10-21 or later.

rules.message: Warning: this code sets temperature, top_p or top_k. This will fail once you move to the 2026-10-21 version (Anthropic removed them in API version 2026-10-21; requests that send them return HTTP 400 on every model).

fix.note: Suggested fix, not applied automatically: 1. Remove temperature, top_p and top_k from this call. 2. If you relied on them (for example temperature 0 for repeatable output), say what you need in the prompt instead. 3. Re-run your evals, then move anthropic-version to 2026-10-21 or later.

confirmed: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 is deprecated and retires on the Claude API on 30 Nov 2026; recommended replacement claude-sonnet-5-5.

claude-sonnet-4-5 is the Claude API alias for Claude Sonnet 4.5 (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), which retires on 30 Nov 2026 (Sonnet 4.5 model page). Undated aliases point to the most recent dated snapshot of their minor version (model IDs page).
Anthropic gives at least 60 days' notice before retiring publicly released models.
Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud set their own retirement schedules; these dates apply to Anthropic-operated platforms only.
temperature, top_p and top_k are deprecated on Claude 4.7 and later models (400 at non-default values).

API version 2026-10-21 removes temperature, top_p and top_k: requests that send them return a 400 error on any model. Earlier API versions reject them only at non-default values on Claude 4.7 and later and Claude Mythos Preview.
unconfirmed: No live API checks: replacements' parameter behaviour beyond the docs is untested.
Other undated aliases (for example claude-opus-4-1, claude-sonnet-4-0, claude-opus-4-0) are not listed: their current status was not confirmed on a current Anthropic page.

next_steps: Swap retired Claude model ids for the recommended replacements, remove temperature/top_p/top_k where targeting Claude 4.7+, and run a regression eval.
Before moving to anthropic-version 2026-10-21 or later, remove temperature/top_p/top_k from every Messages call (Last Orders flags these and never removes them for you).
